jei.jaymospowers.mortar_grinding.how: Up to four at a time, ground with the pestle
jei.jaymospowers.clay_bucket: Scoops water and milks a cow or goat like a bucket. It wears a little every time it's emptied and cracks in the end. Dip it in lava and it shatters.
jei.jaymospowers.brick_form: Carved from a plank with a knife. Clay pressed into it in the grid makes unfired bricks, for the brick kiln; the form wears a little each time.
